stories.title: Medien: Trump verbietet CNN und «Politico» Zugang zum Weißen Haus

en.title: Media: Trump bans CNN and Politico from White House access
en.summary: Trump has restricted White House access for CNN and Politico news outlets.

stories.title: Tankpreis: Regierung einigt sich auf Tankrabatt und Spritpreisdeckel

en.title: Fuel prices: Government agrees on fuel discount and fuel price cap
en.summary: The government coalition has implemented a fuel discount and price cap, reducing fuel prices by 17 cents per liter starting October 1st.

stories.title: Pressefreiheit: Donald Trump verbietet CNN, Politico und MSNOW Zugang zum Weißen Haus

en.title: Press freedom: Donald Trump bars CNN, Politico and MSNBC from White House access
en.summary: Trump has further restricted press freedom by prohibiting CNN, Politico, and MSNBC from reporting at the White House, with additional bans anticipated.

stories.title: US-Präsident Trump verbietet CNN Zugang zum Weißen Haus

en.title: US President Trump bans CNN from White House access
en.summary: Trump has denied CNN and other media outlets access to the White House, accusing them of spreading false information. This follows his previous actions against journalists.

stories.title: Kampf gegen Pressefreiheit: Trump verbietet CNN, „Politico“ und MS Now Zutritt zum Weißen Haus

en.title: Fight against press freedom: Trump bans CNN, Politico and MS Now from White House
en.summary: US President Donald Trump has revoked White House access for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, with additional media outlets facing potential bans.

stories.title: Fußball-Bundesliga: FC Bayern München feiert hohen Sieg gegen Union Berlin und Kane-Rekord

en.title: Bundesliga football: FC Bayern Munich celebrates large victory against Union Berlin and Kane record
en.summary: Bayern Munich defeated Union Berlin with Harry Kane breaking a goal-scoring record, though his teammates also delivered spectacular performances.

stories.title: US-Präsident Trump verbietet CNN Zugang zu Weißem Haus

en.title: US President Trump bans CNN from White House access
en.summary: US President Donald Trump has denied White House access to CNN.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Trump verbietet CNN, Politico und MS Now Zugang zum Weißen Haus

en.title: USA news blog: Trump bans CNN, Politico and MS Now from White House access
en.summary: Trump revoked White House access for CNN, Politico, and MS Now, citing their reporting as containing false information, with further media outlets also facing bans.

stories.title: USA: Pistorius nimmt in Texas ersten F-35-Kampfjet für Deutschland entgegen

en.title: USA: Pistorius receives first F-35 fighter jet for Germany in Texas
en.summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius accepted the first F-35 fighter jet in Texas. Germany will receive a total of eight aircraft.

stories.title: USA: Trump will CNN, »Politico« und MS Now aus Weißem Haus verbannen

en.title: USA: Trump plans to ban CNN, Politico and MS Now from White House
en.summary: Donald Trump announced he will deny access to the White House to two television networks and one news portal. Trump cited alleged fake news as the reason.

stories.title: Steuersenkung um 17 Cent: Bundesregierung einigt sich auf Tankrabatt und Spritpreisdeckel

en.title: Tax reduction of 17 cents: Federal government agrees on fuel discount and fuel price cap
en.summary: In response to high fuel prices, the German coalition government reached agreement on relief measures. The federal states are also involved in the initiative.

stories.title: Bundeswehr: Boris Pistorius nimmt ersten F-35-Tarnkappenjet in den USA entgegen

en.title: Bundeswehr: Boris Pistorius receives first F-35 stealth jet in the USA
en.summary: Lockheed Martin announced the delivery of the first stealth fighter jet to Germany in a promotional video. Defense Minister Boris Pistorius accepted it in Texas, though critics have raised concerns about the high costs.

stories.title: Kommentar: Was hat der Kanzler mit diesem Spritpreispaket angerichtet?!

en.title: Commentary: What has the chancellor done with this fuel price package?!
en.summary: The German government proposed a price cap and fuel tax rebate to address high fuel costs. Critics argue the measures will not justify their cost in tax expenditures and may jeopardize fuel supply.

stories.title: +++ USA +++: Dänemark und USA verkünden Durchbruch im Grönland-Streit

en.title: +++ USA +++: Denmark and USA announce breakthrough in Greenland dispute
en.summary: Denmark and the USA have announced a resolution to their Greenland dispute. The news blog also reports on Trump's media access restrictions, Democratic plans regarding the Trump family, and postal service developments.

stories.title: Hohe Benzinpreise: Koalition einigt sich im Tankstreit – Deutschland bekommt erstmals Spritpreisdeckel

en.title: High petrol prices: Coalition reaches agreement in fuel dispute – Germany introduces fuel price cap for first time
en.summary: German federal and state governments agreed on relief measures for motorists including a fuel price ceiling and reduced taxes on petrol and diesel.

stories.title: Rüstungsprojekte: „Neue Ära“ für die Luftwaffe – Pistorius nimmt erste F-35 in Empfang

en.title: Defense projects: "New era" for the air force – Pistorius receives first F-35
en.summary: Germany's defense minister received the first F-35 stealth fighter jet in Texas. The aircraft can carry nuclear weapons, allowing the German military to participate in nuclear deterrence.

stories.title: Verteidigung: China, Pakistan, Türkei – wer von Trumps F-35-Export an Riad noch profitieren könnte

en.title: Defense: China, Pakistan, Turkey – who could still benefit from Trump's F-35 export to Riyadh
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has long sought the advanced F-35 fighter jet. A 24 billion dollar deal remains controversial, partly due to China's role in the kingdom.
